resolved_requests.steward_recommendation: WAVETABLE-FIRST — you definitely own Ableton, the wavetable-content overlap with the two sibling stewards shipping wavetables right now is real present-tense synergy, and Stage 0 is reconnaissance not generation, so the gzipped-XML overhead is acceptable. Reach for PROFILE-SCHEMA-FIRST instead only if you'd rather settle the cross-synth profile shape before any single-synth choice locks it in.
